key_insight: PanDA combined with its iDDS scheduler enables scalable AI-assisted detector design optimization by orchestrating large simulation + ML workflows across distributed compute resources, turning costly, serial design cycles into parallel, automated optimization loops.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between expensive physics simulations and AI-driven optimization by providing scalable, fault-tolerant orchestration and data management across heterogeneous distributed computing infrastructures, reducing manual effort and turnaround time for detector design studies.
method: Integrate PanDA workflow engine with iDDS to dispatch and schedule heterogeneous jobs (simulations, ML training, inference, evaluations) across grid, cloud, and HPC resources.

Implement iterative AI-assisted optimization loop: run high-fidelity simulations, train ML surrogates or emulators, evaluate candidate designs, and perform distributed parameter sweeps or optimization steps.
Use scalable data staging, result aggregation, and fault-tolerant retries to parallelize thousands of tasks and maintain reproducibility and provenance of runs.
impact: Allows AI/ML practitioners to scale detector-design experiments from handfuls to thousands of parallel jobs, speeding up exploration of design spaces, improving reproducibility, and enabling more sophisticated ML models and surrogate-based optimization at production scale.
